apps.localizedDescription:
3X-UI Manager:

Native mobile clients for managing 3x-ui panels over the REST API — dashboard, inbounds, clients (with QR sharing), nodes, and the Xray config, on the go. Multi-instance: connect to several panels and switch between them from one app.

✅ Compatible with 3x-ui panels up to v3.10.0. The app speaks the panel's stable REST API, so a new panel release does not require a new app version — no need to wait for an app update when the panel bumps (the rare exceptions are noted in this app's release notes). Panel 3.10.0 is one: creating Shadowsocks inbounds and MASQUE support need app v0.15.1 or newer.

This branch (main) holds the Android app (Kotlin + Jetpack Compose), built straight from the repository root.

versions.localizedDescription:
Fixed:

• The client list opens again on panel 3.11.0 when an AmneziaWG client has a keepalive range. Panel 3.11.0 stores a range such as 15-25 as text, and the app expected a number, so the whole list failed to load. A range now loads, shows in the client editor and is saved back unchanged.

Added:

• Keepalive ranges for AmneziaWG clients (panel 3.11.0): the client editor takes 15-25 as well as plain seconds. The app checks the value the way the panel does — 0 to 65535, the lower bound first — and refuses a range when the client is also on a WireGuard inbound, which only takes whole seconds.
• Node administrator API token scope (panel 3.11.0): node sync plus starting panel updates. A token with this scope is no longer listed as full access.
